title: Ball-Lalo Smart Inventory and Order Management System with AI Chatbot
description: A restaurant management system: menu and inventory, orders and billing, table reservations, sales dashboards, and an AI chatbot that answers customers.

caseStudy.problem: The restaurant ran its inventory, orders and reservations on paper. It needed one system for its menu, inventory, point of sale (POS) and table reservations that automates stock tracking, product records and stock-level reports.

features.title: Inventory tracking
features.description: Track stock levels and supplies, with automated stock-level reports.

features.title: Menu management
features.description: Add, edit and price the restaurant's menu items.

features.title: Point of sale (POS) & billing
features.description: Take orders, update their status as they're served, and generate bills.

features.title: Table reservations
features.description: Customers book from a calendar; taken time slots are blocked and reservations update their status automatically.

features.title: Sales & customer analytics
features.description: Dashboard charts of sales data and customer activity.

features.title: Ratings & feedback
features.description: Customers rate their dining experience and leave feedback.

features.title: Role-based accounts
features.description: Separate admin, staff and customer accounts, each with its own dashboard.

features.title: AI chatbot assistance
features.description: A GPT-4o-mini restaurant assistant that answers customers' questions about reservations, dining and policies.

outcomes: Replaced paper-based records with one system for stock, sales and orders.
Automated stock-level reports that used to take much longer to prepare by hand.
Added an AI chatbot that answers customers' questions.

title: Sassy Strands Inventory & Production Tracker
description: One web app that replaces the client's Excel workbooks for inventory, client orders and production tracking.

caseStudy.problem: The client tracked bundle and closure inventory, available stock and client orders across several Excel workbooks. The goal was a single system for stock, orders and production, with access controlled by role.

features.title: Inventory and stock movements
features.description: Stock movements and running balances for bundles and closures, with pricing.

features.title: Client order monitoring
features.description: Track client orders and their OR numbers in one place.

features.title: Production stages and QA
features.description: Follow each order through production stages and quality assurance.

features.title: Spreadsheet import
features.description: Imports the client's existing workbooks and flags every row it cannot read cleanly.

features.title: Role-based access
features.description: Owner, Admin, Inventory, Production and QA roles enforced in the database with row-level security.

features.title: Reports
features.description: Reports built from the live inventory and order data.

outcomes: Replaced the client's Excel workbooks with one web app for inventory, client orders, production and QA.
Five staff roles (Owner, Admin, Inventory, Production, QA) each see only what they need, enforced in the database.
Imported the client's existing spreadsheets automatically, flagging every row that needed review.
